intro: The Summit holds the highest elevations in Rough Hollow, with homes priced from $1M. CleanzATX cleans the windows up here with water fed poles and pure water, whatever the wind is doing.

paragraphs: The Summit is the high point of Rough Hollow, and the homes here start at about $1M. It is a small section, it is not gated, and it falls under the Rough Hollow HOA. Because of the height, it has the widest views in the community.

Expect large windows facing outward and, in some cases, glass on every side of the house. Rooflines are higher and more exposed than in lower sections, which means more wind and more sun on the glass.

Wind is steady at the top of the ridge. It drives pollen into window seals and dust onto the glass, and it does so more quickly than in sheltered sections. After a windy week, even a freshly cleaned pane looks tired.

Rain also hits the glass hard at this height. That brings mud splatter along the lower panes and runoff stains below the sills. We use pure water so the glass dries clean, and the 7 day touch up covers any rain that falls soon after.

Our crew plans around the wind. We start on the side that is most sheltered, keep the poles steady and finish where the gusts are strongest when they are calm. The Summit pairs well with Vista Ridge Estates and The Overlook for scheduling.

A 4,000 sq ft home is about $400 for exterior windows, which takes around three hours outside. Interior adds about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft. If you want to spread the cost across the year, the Twice a Year plan saves 10%.

faq.q: Is it harder to clean windows at the highest point?
faq.a: Wind is the main thing. We adjust the order and wait for calmer moments, but the job is no harder for us.

faq.q: Do you wash the siding too?
faq.a: Yes. House soft wash starts at $0.20 per sq ft with a $400 minimum, and it works well on stucco.

faq.q: What if it rains after the visit?
faq.a: Text a photo within 7 days. We return free when we are in the area, and plan members have the 7 day rain guarantee.

faq.q: Is a plan worth it for an exposed home?
faq.a: Often. Quarterly takes 15% off and lets us catch dust and pollen before it builds up.
